summary: Lutheran daughter of the Jettenbach smith Abraham Lampert and wife of Johann Nickel Grub; John's 7th-great-grandmother.
bio: Elisabetha Margaretha Lampert was born on 12 December 1702 at Jettenbach in the Palatinate and baptized five days later in the Lutheran parish of Reichenbach, the daughter of Abraham Lampert, the smith of Jettenbach, and his wife Maria Sara. Her mother is identified as Maria Sara Jung (about 1678–before 1721), a daughter of Paul Jung and Maria Barbara and previously the widow of Johann Philipp Wirth, who had married Abraham at Glan-Münchweiler on 6 October 1699. Among the godparents at the baptism was Conrad, son of Hans Peter Grub of Jettenbach, a sign that the Lampert and Grub families were close long before Elisabetha Margaretha married Johann Nickel Grub in 1720. She died at Jettenbach on 8 May 1749 and was buried there the next day. She is John's 7th-great-grandmother.

researchNotes:
Born 12 Dec 1702 at Jettenbach, Lutheran, daughter of Abraham Lampert, smith (Schmied) of Jettenbach; married Johann Nickel Grub 1720.

Round 4 read her baptism in the Reichenbach Lutheran register ([R4-S1]). On 17 Dec 1702 Abraham Lamperti of Jettenbach and his wife Maria Sara had their daughter Elisabetha Margretha baptized, five days after the 12 Dec birth on the site. Among the godparents was Conrad, son of Hans Peter Grub of Jettenbach, so the two families were close long before her marriage to Nickel Grub in 1720. The entry names her mother only as Maria Sara. FamilySearch identifies her as Maria Sara Jung (c.1678-before 1721), daughter of Paul Jung and Maria Barbara, and earlier the widow of Johann Philipp Wirth, and dates her marriage to Abraham at Glan-Münchweiler to 6 Oct 1699 ([R4-S2]). FamilySearch gives Elisabetha Margaretha's death as 8 May 1749 at Jettenbach, with burial the next day ([R4-S2]).
